# U.S. Pharmacopeia Store

> The official online store for USP reference standards, pharmaceutical testing products, and educational resources.

U.S. Pharmacopeia (USP) is a scientific nonprofit organization that sets standards for medicines, food ingredients, and dietary supplements. The store provides access to reference standards, performance verification testing (PVT) products, educational subscriptions, and comprehensive compendia including USP-NF, Food Chemicals Codex, and specialized resources for dietary supplements, herbal medicines, and compounding.

## Key Topics

- Reference Standards
- USP-NF
- Performance Verification Testing (PVT)
- Food Chemicals Codex
- Pharmaceutical Testing
- USP Education
- Dietary Supplements Compendia
- Herbal Medicines Compendia
- USP Compounding Compendium
- Product Catalog
- Bulk Order
- CSV Import
- Supply Chain
- SKU Management
- USP Dictionary

## Store & Shopping

- [U.S. Pharmacopeia Store Homepage](https://store.usp.org): Main store entry point with reference standards and testing products catalog
- [Home Page](https://store.usp.org/home): Featured reference standards catalog and Performance Verification Testing (PVT) solutions
- [Quick Order](https://store.usp.org/quickorder): Bulk ordering interface with CSV import and batch upload capabilities for streamlined product procurement

## Products & Subscriptions

- [USP Education 1-Year Subscription](https://store.usp.org/product/2ES0001): Tiered educational subscription with user-based pricing for access to USP learning resources

## Optional Resources

- [Sitemap](https://store.usp.org/sitemap): Directory of USP standards including USP-NF, Food Chemicals Codex, and specialized compendia for dietary supplements, herbal medicines, and compounding
